question: If I order crayons today to a California address, how many days will delivery take? And can opened crayons be returned, and is there any fee?
answer: Most orders take 2–7 business days to arrive, though delivery times vary by carrier and destination and larger orders may take longer. Orders placed before noon PST are processed within 1 business day; those placed after noon are processed within 2 business days. Opened crayons would not meet the return policy’s requirement that items be unused and in the same condition as received; the policy doesn’t specify a separate fee for opened items. Return shipping costs are your responsibility, and any original shipping costs are non-refundable.
